headline: Estrela come home as clear favourites against bottom-side Casa Pia
summary: Estrela lost their last league game 0-1 at Arouca, though they created 1.45 expected goals that day. On Saturday they return home to the Estádio José Gomes, on a newly laid pitch, to host Casa Pia. The visitors are 17th with only 4 points, and their one league win came away, 2-1 at Estoril; they also lose midfielder Abdu Dafé, sent off in the cup. So the market makes Estrela 56% to win, with the handicap giving Casa Pia a 0.75-goal head start. The goal line is 2.5, with Over at only 47.7% — a tight game is expected.
read: Estrela are back at the Estádio José Gomes, on a newly laid pitch, and the market makes them 56.0% favourites against a Casa Pia side 17th of 18 with a -14 goal difference. The fair line has Estrela about three-quarters of a goal the better team, with the goal total set just under two and a half.

facts.fact: Estrela are 56.0% to win at home, roughly three times Casa Pia's 18.8%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Estrela clear favourites for their first game back at their own ground.

facts.fact: Estrela are back at the Estádio José Gomes for round nine, where a newly laid pitch will be unveiled.
facts.meaning: A true home game at their own stadium, on a surface nobody in this league has played on yet.

facts.fact: Casa Pia are 17th of 18 with four points from eight games and a goal difference of -14.
facts.meaning: They arrive as the struggling side in this fixture, despite a cup win at the weekend.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is -0.75: the market rates Estrela about three-quarters of a goal the better team.
facts.meaning: Estrela are expected not just to win but to win by a margin, not by a single goal.

facts.fact: Estrela created 1.45 xG at Arouca on 11 October and lost 0-1.
facts.meaning: Their results have run below their chance creation — that defeat came in a game they largely controlled.

facts.fact: Estrela beat Casa Pia 4-0 at home in the league last March.
facts.meaning: The last league meeting at this ground was one-sided in Estrela's favour.

facts.fact: Casa Pia's 1-0 cup win at Alpendorada on Sunday cost them midfielder Abdu Dafé, sent off and unavailable here.
facts.meaning: They lose a midfield option for a game in which they will spend long spells without the ball.

facts.fact: Patrick Sequeira started in Casa Pia's goal in the Taça, his first start of the season.
facts.meaning: Casa Pia may now have a settled goalkeeper for the trip rather than a rotating one.

sources.fact: Patrick Sequeira returned to the Casa Pia goal in the Taça de Portugal match at Alpendorada, his first start of the season.
David Sousa is available again for the Casa Pia defence after serving a suspension.
Midfielder Abdu Dafé is unavailable for Casa Pia after being sent off in the Taça de Portugal match.
Casa Pia progressed to the next round of the Taça de Portugal, which is reported as good news for Sequeira's chances of more minutes.
Felipe Silva celebrated Casa Pia's qualification in the Taça de Portugal before the team turns back to the Liga Portugal trip to Estrela da Amadora.
Estrela da Amadora will play Casa Pia at the Estádio José Gomes, with the club officially confirming the return to their home ground for the ninth round match on Saturday 24 October at 15:30.
Estrela da Amadora's new pitch at the Estádio José Gomes is ready and will be unveiled in the match against Casa Pia.
The Estádio José Gomes pitch was renovated during the international break after the club received several criticisms.
